sources.excerpt: FIRST LOOK! Pharaoh Supreme and Black Sheep | Black Arts Toneworks Menu Pedals News Swag Friends & Retailers Contact   FIRST LOOK! Pharaoh Supreme and Black Sheep Two new pedals to be debuted at Winter Namm. Pharaoh supreme which does all that the Gold Standard Pharaoh does, but with the addition of a input gain control and 6 way diode clipping, it can go both softer and more subtle to more aggressive and brash. The Black Sheep is an all transistor fuzz device with enough attitude and rough edges to deserve its name. Watch out for some quick video demos pre/namm, and after Namm, we will get to work on a more expansive demo for each. Stay Black! © 2026 Black Arts Toneworks. All Rights Reserved.
